test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Anand personally believes in the motto,__ "When life gives you lemons, make lemonade."__

options.text: Earn the maximum out of business
Enjoy the most when the season is favourable
Make the best out of difficult situations

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Make the best out of difficult situations. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"When life gives you lemons, make lemonade"** means making the best out of difficult situations. (कठिन परिस्थितियों का सर्वश्रेष्ठ बनाना) • **Example:** Despite the setbacks, she always manages to turn things around. Truly, when life gives her lemons, she makes lemonade. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Make the best out of difficult situations. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: __ • **Earn the maximum out of business** (व्यापार से अधिकतम कमाई करना): To make the highest possible profit from business. • **Example:** His goal was to earn the maximum out of business, always looking for new opportunities. • **Nourish health** (स्वास्थ्य को पोषित करना): To take care of and improve one's health. • **Example:** Regular exercise and a balanced diet help to nourish health. • **Enjoy the most when the season is favourable** (जब मौसम अनुकूल हो तो सबसे अधिक आनंद लें): To take full advantage of good times. • **Example:** They decided to enjoy the most when the season is favourable, planning picnics and outdoor activities. 145:Ta69, The correct answer is **habit**__.
